decisions.reason: The encrypted second-channel communication sits at the core of the firm's authentication and cryptography know-how and its stated strategy of binding mobile communication, so the firm can interpret its results and keep improving it.

The multi-layer end-to-end security architecture builds directly on the firm's deep cryptography and SDK expertise and was promoted to its own page in 2019, which signals that management sees continued value in it.

The QR-code hardware token draws on the firm's existing hardware options and transaction-signing know-how and received its own page in 2019, but hardware tokens face pressure from app-based authentication, which leaves moderate risk.

The payment network compliance suite is further from the firm's core identity and authentication knowledge and was only ever mentioned, never featured, but it still fits the firm's regulatory security positioning for financial customers, so it stays for now.
